data.description: Within each group, models share a weekly limit and a 5-hour limit. Quota is consumed proportionally to the cost of the tokens. The 5-hour limit smooths out aggregate demand to fairly distribute global capacity across all users, while your weekly limit is tied directly to your individual tier.
